official_definition: [Step Timing] - Change: Cost X (Reductions) (This effect can be used from your hand). [Effect]. After that effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your [condition] Spirit's with this card in refreshed condition. If the Spirit is currently battling, continue the battle.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Change] or [Change: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Change]", "give [Change]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
